name: Exec Cluster E04: Tick-Based Risk Unit
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E04: Tick-Based Risk Unit
# Tests: risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.ticks)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

fast = ma(period=20, type=MAType.ema)(close)
slow = ma(period=50, type=MAType.ema)(close)
is_bull = fast > slow
held = hold_until(is_bull, not is_bull)

long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.ticks)(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=10)
